info.title: Raven Hosted Verifier
info.description: Signed, scope-bounded evidence receipts for Solana tokens. A receipt v1 records which checks were performed, which were deliberately not performed, and which surfaces Raven cannot attest to at all (coverageGaps) — then signs that body under the domain-separated `raven-receipt` / v1 envelope so any consumer can verify it offline against a signer key they pin themselves. POST /receipt/v1 is the primary integration path and fails closed: when required evidence cannot be established it returns an unsigned 422 receipt_unavailable refusal and issues no receipt. A receipt is evidence, never a decision and never an authorization: receipt integrity, signer trust, freshness, coverage, and consumer policy are separate axes and are never collapsed into a single boolean. Raven never declares a token safe. Server-side RPC; callers never supply infrastructure. POST /verify remains available for legacy v2 attestation compatibility. Not financial advice.

post.summary: Primary: issue a fail-closed signed receipt v1
post.description:
Issues a scope-bounded, liability-safe receipt v1 (`raven-receipt` / v1). The response body IS the receipt object; there is no wrapper envelope on success.

Separation of concerns — these five questions are answered independently and MUST NOT be collapsed:
1. **Receipt integrity** — recompute `payloadHash` over the canonical JSON of the body minus {signature, signerPublicKey, payloadHash, receiptId}, confirm `receiptId` equals "raven-receipt-v1:" + payloadHash, then verify the ed25519 `signature` over canonicalJson({domain:"raven-receipt",version:"v1",payloadHash}). This establishes receipt integrity and control of the signing key — nothing more; attribution to Raven is the separate signer-trust axis below.
2. **Signer trust** — whether you accept `signerPublicKey` is YOUR policy. Pin the key independently and out-of-band; a receipt vouching for its own key proves nothing. This axis is orthogonal to integrity.
3. **Freshness** — compute age = now - `timestamp` and compare against the signed `maxAgeSeconds`. A stale receipt is still cryptographically valid; staleness means old, never tampered. You MAY apply a stricter budget, never a looser one.
4. **Coverage** — `scopeChecksPerformed`, `scopeChecksNotPerformed`, and `coverageGaps` bound what the receipt does and does not claim. Silence is never safety. Anything in `coverageGaps` is unverified, full stop.
5. **Consumer policy and authorization** — whether the evidence is sufficient, and whether any action is permitted, is entirely the consumer's decision. Raven issues evidence; it does not decide and does not authorize. A valid, fresh, fully covered receipt is still not permission to act.

The signing domain is separate from the v2 attestation domain: a v2 verifier MUST NOT accept a receipt-v1 signature and a receipt-v1 verifier MUST NOT accept a v2 signature, even when the same key signs both.

schema.description: Callers never supply infrastructure: rpcUrl and issuerIdentity are rejected with 400.

request_id.description: Optional caller-supplied request identifier used for correlation during processing. Never required. It is not part of the signed receipt body and is not echoed in the response.

poolAddress.description: Optional Raydium CPMM pool for liquidity/vault evidence.

200.description: Signed receipt v1. The body is the receipt object itself. The optional RPC status header is unauthenticated operational provenance and is not part of the receipt signature.

Raven-RPC-Core-Status.description: Optional, unauthenticated operational provenance for core-account acquisition. It sits outside the receipt body and outside the signature: intermediaries may strip or alter it without invalidating the receipt. Consumers MUST NOT treat it as receipt authority, as proof of truth, or as an input to a trust decision.

400.description: invalid_request — malformed addresses, or the forbidden fields rpcUrl / issuerIdentity were supplied.

401.description: unauthorized — missing or unknown API key.

422.description: receipt_unavailable — the request was well-formed, but the chain state required to satisfy it could not be established. This is the fail-closed refusal: the response is UNSIGNED and no receipt is issued. The body deliberately carries no signature, signerPublicKey, receiptId, findings, or slot — nothing a consumer could mistake for a receipt. A consumer MUST treat this as 'no evidence', never as a negative result about the token and never as a soft pass.

Raven-RPC-Core-Status.description: Optional, unauthenticated operational provenance; not receipt authority and never an input to a trust decision.

500.description: cannot_issue_receipt — the receipt could not be produced or signed (including a producer-side forbidden-word fail-closed or canonicalization failure). No unsigned receipt is ever served in its place.

503.description: signer_unavailable — fail-closed: an official verifier that cannot sign does not serve.

post.description:
LEGACY COMPATIBILITY SURFACE. Retained unchanged for integrations built against the `raven-official-attestation` / v2 envelope; its shape, two-layer hash (replayHash + officialAttestationHash), and signing rules are frozen. New integrations should use POST /receipt/v1, which is the primary path and carries explicit scope and coverage as first-class signed fields.

The v2 `verdict` enum is a legacy engine outcome label. It is not a safety rating, not a score, and not an authorization: it does not tell a caller what to do, and consumer policy remains the caller's own. `coverageGaps` bounds every response — anything listed there is unverified regardless of the verdict value.

schema.description: Callers never supply infrastructure: rpcUrl and issuerIdentity are rejected with 400.

poolAddress.description: Optional Raydium CPMM pool for liquidity/vault evidence.

verdict.description: Legacy v2 engine outcome label. Not a safety claim, not a score, not an authorization to act.

coverageGaps.description: Surfaces NOT evaluated for this response. Always present, always honest. Anything listed here is unverified.

replayHash.description: sha256 over the canonical replay input.

signature.description: ed25519 over the domain-separated v2 preimage; verify against an independently pinned signer key (GET /pubkey is discovery/cross-check only; accept its material only if it matches your pin or chains from it). This signature is NOT valid for receipt v1 and vice versa.

rpc.description: Observed slot + request echo for replay.

503.description: signer_unavailable (fail-closed: an official verifier that cannot sign does not serve)

get.description: Publishes the key(s) for the legacy `raven-official-attestation` / v2 domain. Receipt v1 carries its own `signerPublicKey` in the receipt body and is verified against a key the consumer pins independently — publication here is not, by itself, a trust decision for any consumer.

200.description: keys[] with keyId, publicKeyBase64 (ed25519 SPKI), domain raven-official-attestation, version v2

get.summary: Always-200 liveness, signer and RPC reachability

200.description: Always HTTP 200. With dual RPC enabled, rpcWitnesses reports configured/reachable paths only and does not claim per-request corroboration.
Signer available and at least one RPC reachable. One of two reachable is explicitly degraded.

503.description: No signer, zero reachable RPCs, or bounded active core-account divergence latch.

ApiKey.name: x-api-key
ApiKey.description: Invite-gated alpha. Request at https://ravenattest.com/request-access.html. Bearer auth also accepted.

ReceiptV1.description: Scope-bounded, liability-safe receipt v1. Every field below except signature, signerPublicKey, payloadHash and receiptId is part of the signed preimage. Findings carry no severity: the receipt conveys observed on-chain state and nothing beyond it.

timestamp.description: Observation time (estimated block time of slot). Basis for the freshness axis.

rulesVersion.description: Exact rules identity used. Dispatch is exact string equality; a verifier MUST NOT parse it numerically and apply newer rules to an older artifact.

scopeChecksPerformed.description: Stable codes for every check that WAS run. Sorted ascending.

scopeChecksNotPerformed.description: Stable codes for in-catalogue checks deliberately NOT run for this receipt. Sorted ascending. Stated as loudly as what was performed — silence is never safety.

coverageGaps.description: Authoritative limitation list: surfaces Raven cannot attest to at all. Anything here is unverified. Sorted ascending.

findings.description: Fact-only evidence objects, sorted by code. No severity field exists by design.

evidence.description: Raw on-chain evidence backing the finding.

interpretations.description: Fact-only plain-language restatements of findings, sorted by code. Never a prediction, score, or recommendation.

maxAgeSeconds.description: Producer-stated, signed freshness budget. Consumers SHOULD treat the receipt as stale when now - timestamp exceeds it, MAY apply a stricter budget, and MUST NOT silently relax it.

disclaimer.description: Mandatory exact string, part of the signed preimage. Verifiers MUST compare byte-for-byte and reject any deviation. Renderers MUST display it and MUST NOT truncate, paraphrase, or de-emphasize it.
disclaimer.example: This attestation reports on-chain state within the defined scope at the stated slot. It is not a prediction, recommendation, or declaration of safety.

payloadHash.description: sha256 over the canonical preimage (body minus signature, signerPublicKey, payloadHash, receiptId). Not itself in the preimage.

receiptId.description: "raven-receipt-v1:" + payloadHash. Derived after payloadHash, so there is no circularity. Strict deduplication uses the full payloadHash.

signature.description: base64 ed25519 over the UTF-8 bytes of canonicalJson({domain:"raven-receipt",version:"v1",payloadHash}). Domain-separated: never valid under the v2 attestation domain.

signerPublicKey.description: base64 SPKI DER ed25519 public key the signature verifies against. Whether to TRUST this key is a separate, consumer-side decision — pin it independently and out-of-band.

ReceiptUnavailable.description: Unsigned fail-closed refusal. No receipt was issued. Carries no signature, signerPublicKey, receiptId, findings, or slot by design.

reason.description: Exact machine-readable cause of the refusal.

details.description: Optional supporting reason strings; may be an empty array.

error.description: Stable error code, e.g. invalid_request, unauthorized, signer_unavailable, engine_error, engine_timeout, cannot_issue_receipt.
